query: How do I apply for lower TDS certificate in Tamil Nadu?
reference_answer:
Lower TDS Certificate Application:
To apply for a lower TDS certificate in Tamil Nadu, submit Form 13 to the Income Tax Department. You can download the form from the official income tax website or visit the nearest Income Tax Office. Attach required documents, such as PAN card and income proof.
answer: To apply for a lower TDS certificate in Tamil Nadu, visit the official website of the Department of Revenue in Tamil Nadu, fill out the application form, and submit it along with necessary documents at the nearest revenue office. [Document 1]
